title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Pechanga Resort & Casino, Temecula | 2026
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band kicked off their 2026 tour with a concert at the Pechanga Resort & Casino in Temecula, California, USA, on 28 May 2026.

It was the first show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s tour of the USA, which lasted for 12 dates in May and June 2026.

They were joined on the final song, a version of The Beatles’ ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’, by Extreme guitarist Nuno Bettencourt.

The All-Starr Band previously performed at the Pechanga Resort & Casino on 19 May 2023.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

  • ‘Octopus’s Garden’
